The '''Reidi Artom IV system''' was a system discovered by [[Reidi Artom]]. It was eventually renamed with a local or ancient name. The discovery of this system was not particularly profitable for its discoverer.<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
